note: An unnamed researcher's honeypot result relayed second-hand, with no date or source link. A honeypot on a vulnerable build (8.4.26 is below the fixed 8.4.27) shows scanning and exploitation of decoys, not compromise of real sites.

claim: Microsoft's chief executive Satya Nadella, at an AI Tour event in Germany, said of the PHP vulnerability that he had not seen anything like it in a long, long time
note: A reaction quote by a technology executive, relayed second-hand; it says nothing about exploitation or compromise.

claim: The US NSA urged all organisations using PHP to update at once or disable vulnerable systems, and agencies in Japan, Singapore, Australia and the EU issued similar warnings
note: Second-hand; Computing (cur14-computing-nsa-offline) and Bangkok Biz News repeat the NSA advice, while Notebookcheck attributes the take-offline advice to CISA (cur14-nbc-fr-cisa); the issuing agency should be checked at the primary.
